conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional failed destination and return lifecycle
conditional_findings.classification: New95e source-level error identity question connected to earlier Segovb542 and Adler245 pending destination failure scope; no new historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Destination-specific generation outcome and RetainedScene location/root/error relationship.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: A failed new-location generated_scene result is stored in the existing retained scene before its location and root are replaced, so the error has no retained destination identity.
conditional_findings.trace: With a resident scene A and a matching requested/document location B, retain_scene calls document.generated_scene before despawning A or resetting RetainedScene. If that call returns Err, it assigns scene.error and returns, leaving scene.location=A and the old root. If a later matching valid document/view for A reaches retain_scene without a reset, the same-location error guard returns immediately. Status separately requires scene.error.is_none for installation and serializes that error. This is source-level branch reasoning; no A/B navigation, request, failure, update loop or UI was executed.
conditional_findings.producer_safeguards: The browser request controller waits for prepareGeneratedScene to finish before installing a document and serializes overlapping worker ownership; generation finish validates the input and records the exact owner/ticket/digest, and activate rejects stale or mismatched preparation. These protections constrain, but do not by themselves prove impossible, an error after installation. The old scene/root are deliberately retained on destination generation failure, and explicit scene release or successful replacement may reset state.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: A concrete supported transition that produces a post-install generated_scene error followed by return to A has not been demonstrated; native non-Wasm generation and manually supplied invalid requests are distinct paths. The controller may fail before installing B, the user may not return while the old resource persists, and later unseen systems or policy may intentionally end the session. This is not the previously recorded same-location place-identity mismatch or the local generated-prefix issue.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After full audit and separate implementation authorization, bind generation failures to the requested destination or a separate request outcome, and define which transitions retain, clear or retry the resident scene without losing typed error causes; coordinate ticket activation and browser request status.
acceptance_requirements: A failed destination reports its own error without making an unrelated still-resident scene permanently fail when a supported return/retry occurs; genuine same-scene errors remain explicit.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; exact branch sequence and ticket safeguards traced, supported post-install failure/return producer, schedules, retry policy and aliases remain open
